Question 2
?

Find the fourth-degree Taylor polynomial of cos2⁡(x) about x=π.

a
1−(x−π)+12(x−π)3
b
1−2(x−π)2+13(x−π)4
c
1−(x−π)2+13(x−π)4
d
1−4(x−π)+14(x−π)3
e
1−(x−π)2+23(x−π)4
